Head Anatomy Guide

Scalp, face, parotid, mastication, TMJ
Start here: learn the four directions, then use the map
AnteriorFront, toward the face
PosteriorBack, toward the occiput
MedialToward the midline (the nose line)
LateralAway from the midline, toward the ear

These words are colored the same in every sentence. Above each drawing, a compass shows which side of the picture is anterior, posterior, superior and inferior.

  1. Tap a sentence: its spot lights up in gold with an arrow and a name.
  2. Tap a numbered dot: the sentences about it light up.
  3. Next / Prev walks through the sentences. Names shows every label, Pins hides them, Zoom enlarges.
